'''August 2002 Durham tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Northgate Mall, Durham, NC on 17 August 2002. [[John Irving]] won it. It is known from Lewis Blake's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3919">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-08-18-durham-nc-8-17-02d3919/ durham-nc-8-17-02], DeckTech (Lewis "Duke Devil" Blake, 18 August 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-08-18-durham-nc-8-17-02d3919/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 17 August 2002
* '''Site:''' Northgate Mall, Durham, NC
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Winner:''' [[John Irving]]
